description_en: Modifies the name, description, or automatic route propagation feature of a VPN gateway
description_zh: 调用ModifyVpnGatewayAttribute接口修改VPN网关的名称、描述信息或路由自动传播功能
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vpn-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpnGatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: VPN网关实例所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token only supports ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the VPN gateway.  

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Other special characters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关的新名称。  

长度为2～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头，需要以大写或小写字母开头，后面可包含大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.），不支持其他特殊字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the VPN gateway.  
 
The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关新的描述信息。  
 
描述信息长度为1～100个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic route propagation feature for the VPN gateway. Valid values:

true: enables the feature.

    After automatic route propagation is enabled, the VPN gateway instance automatically learns system routes in the system route table of the VPC and automatically propagates routes of the on-premises data center to the system route table of the VPC.
false: disables the feature.
    
    Before you disable automatic route propagation, make sure that the BGP dynamic route feature is disabled for all IPsec-VPN connections under the VPN gateway
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启VPN网关的路由自动传播功能。取值：

true：开启。

    开启路由自动传播后，VPN网关实例会自动学习VPC实例系统路由表中的系统路由，并向VPC实例系统路由表自动传播本地数据中心的路由。
false：关闭。
    
    关闭路由自动传播前，请确保VPN网关下的所有IPsec连接已关闭BGP动态路由功能
parameters.name: auto_propagate

AutoPropagate.description_en:
Specifies whether BGP routes are automatically propagated to the VPC. Valid values:

true: automatically propagated

false: not automatically propagated
AutoPropagate.description_zh:
BGP路由是否自动传播到VPC。取值：

true：自动传播。

false：不自动传播

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The billing status of the VPN gateway instance. Valid values:

Normal: normal
FinancialLocked: locked due to overdue payments
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
VPN网关实例的付费状态。取值：

Normal：正常。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the VPN gateway was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX time format. It indicates the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
VPN网关实例的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建VPN网关实例时的总时长

Description.description_en: The description of the VPN gateway

DisasterRecoveryInternetIp.description_en:
The second IP address assigned by the system to the VPN gateway for creating an IPsec-VPN connection.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateways that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
DisasterRecoveryInternetIp.description_zh:
系统为VPN网关实例分配的用于创建IPsec-VPN连接的第二个IP地址。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId.description_en:
The ID of the second vSwitch associated with the VPN gateway.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateways that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId.description_zh:
VPN网关实例关联的第二个交换机ID。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

EnableBgp.description_en:
Specifies whether the BGP feature is enabled for the VPN gateway. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
EnableBgp.description_zh:
VPN网关BGP功能的开启状态。取值：

true：开启。

false：未开启

EndTime.description_en:
The UNIX timestamp of when the VPN gateway instance expires. Unit: milliseconds.

The UNIX timestamp follows the UNIX time format. It indicates the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC until the VPN gateway instance expires
EndTime.description_zh:
VPN网关实例的到期时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至VPN网关实例到期时的总时长

InternetIp.description_en:
If the VPN gateway supports single-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this parameter indicates the IP address of the VPN gateway, which can be used to create an IPsec-VPN connection or an SSL-VPN connection.

If the VPN gateway supports dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this parameter indicates the first IP address used to create an IPsec-VPN connection. It cannot be used to create an SSL-VPN connection.

    If the VPN gateway supports dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, the system assigns two IPsec addresses to the VPN gateway for creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
InternetIp.description_zh:
在VPN网关实例支持创建单隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，该地址为VPN网关实例的IP地址，可用于创建IPsec-VPN连接或SSL-VPN连接。

在VPN网关实例支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，该地址为用于创建IPsec-VPN连接的第一个IP地址，不能用于创建SSL-VPN连接。

    在VPN网关实例支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，系统会为VPN网关实例分配两个IPsec地址，用于创建双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接

IntranetIp.description_en:
The private IP address of the vSwitch that is occupied when the system deploys the VPN gateway.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateways that support only single-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections and have the IPsec-VPN feature enabled
IntranetIp.description_zh:
系统部署VPN网关实例时占用的交换机私网IP地址。

仅支持单隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数，且该VPN网关实例需已开启IPsec-VPN功能

Name.description_en: The name of the VPN gateway

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
VPN网关实例所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

Spec.description_en: The bandwidth specification of the VPN gateway. Unit: Mbit/s
Spec.description_zh: VPN网关实例的带宽规格。单位：Mbps

SslVpnInternetIp.description_en:
The IP address of the SSL-VPN connection.

This parameter is returned only after the SSL-VPN feature is enabled for a VPN gateway instance of the public network type that supports dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
SslVpnInternetIp.description_zh:
SSL-VPN连接的IP地址。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的公网网络类型的VPN网关实例开启SSL-VPN功能后，才会返回当前参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

init: initializing
provisioning: preparing
active: active
updating: updating
deleting: deleting
Status.description_zh:
VPN网关的状态。

init：初始化。
provisioning：准备中。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch associated with the VPN gateway
VSwitchId.description_zh: VPN网关实例关联的交换机ID

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the VPN gateway belongs

VpnGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
